program.title: Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS)
program.description: Develop executive decision-making, strategic marketing, financial acumen, and enterprise leadership skills designed for top global corporations.
program.overview: The Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) is a premier 3-year undergraduate degree structured under NEP guidelines, bridging foundational business theory with real-world corporate case studies and internships.

program.title: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)
program.description: Comprehensive foundation in accounting, taxation, auditing, and global corporate finance principles.
program.overview: The Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) program equips students with rigorous accounting skills, tax planning frameworks, and deep financial literacy required for modern corporate auditing and banking careers.

program.title: Bachelor of Science in IT (B.Sc IT)
program.description: Cutting-edge technical curriculum covering software engineering, cloud workflows, and data structures.
program.overview: The B.Sc IT program provides immersive training in full-stack software development, database architecture, cybersecurity protocols, and cloud computing infrastructure.
